drills.title: Tank Absolute Pressure via Manometer (SG = 0.85, h = 55 cm)
drills.preview: A manometer with fluid SG = 0.85 shows column height h = 55 cm on a gas tank where Patm = 96 kPa. Determine the absolute pressure in the tank.

drills.title: Hydrostatic Force & Pressure Center on a Submerged Car Door
drills.preview: A car lands at the bottom of a lake with the top edge of its 1.2 m × 1.0 m vertical door 8 m below the free surface. Find FR and yP.

drills.title: Centerline Water Pipe Velocity from Piezometer & Pitot Tube
drills.preview: A piezometer and Pitot tube tapped into a horizontal water pipe read h₁ = 3 cm, h₂ = 7 cm, and excess stagnation rise h₃ = 12 cm. Find V₁.

drills.title: Pin-and-Strut Supported Cantilever Beam Reactions
drills.preview: Determine the horizontal and vertical components of reaction at pin A and the force in two-force strut CD under the 4 kN tip load.

drills.title: Minimum Horizontal Force P to Prevent Leaning 30-kg Rod Sliding
drills.preview: Rod AB (30 kg) leans on a 3–4–5 geometry against a rough vertical wall at A (μs = 0.2) and smooth floor at B. Find minimum P.

drills.title: Centroidal Moment of Inertia Ix' of an Inverted T-Beam
drills.preview: Locate centroid ȳ = 60 mm and compute Ix' about the centroidal horizontal axis for the 150 mm × 30 mm flange and 30 mm × 150 mm web.
